edit.description: manager from packageManager, not lockfile presence

summary: the program's package.json `packageManager` names the manager install spawns and the tool reads; install's scaffold writes it; a fieldless package.json refuses naming the remedy
acceptance: a fresh install writes packageManager; a root packageManager of pnpm@… is copied and install and the tool use pnpm; a .temper/package.json with no field refuses with the add-the-field remedy; an existing package.json stays byte-identical
tests: a package manager field naming pnpm makes the tool use pnpm
a program package json with no package manager field refuses naming the remedy
notes: 0100; spec 529865c9 answers the park (scaffold: root's field, else npm@<npm --version>). Dogfood .temper/package.json already declares npm. A fieldless harness predating the rule is the release's migration note, not a fallback. yarn/bun keep the by-name refusal. Shares src/install.rs with PACKAGE-JSON-IS-SCAFFOLDED-ONCE's seam (the `missing` render line may name the declared manager). Install's scaffold half split out (inbox 2026-11-26-install-writes-the-package-manager).
